name: DateField
summary: A date typed in its parts, day, month and year, in the locale's order: three labelled boxes, or one field of parts that step with the arrow keys. Not for choosing a date near today from a calendar (DatePicker, which uses the segmented form for typing).
a11y: Separate: a `fieldset` named by the label as its `legend`, three inputs named "Day", "Month", "Year" with numeric keyboards (the month also takes words), autocomplete for a birth date when the label asks for one. Segmented: a `group` named by the label with one `spinbutton` per part, its range and "Empty" when not filled. A problem says which part is missing or wrong, and is checked when focus leaves the date, never while typing.

keys.action: segmented: one more or less; wraps
segmented: types into the part, then moves on
segmented: the previous or next part

props.name: label
props.description: What the date is, sentence case: "Date of birth", "Passport issue date".

props.name: value
props.description: The date as `YYYY-MM-DD`, or null when empty.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new date once day, month and year make a real date, or null when all are cleared.

props.name: hint
props.description: Defaults to an example in the locale's order, e.g. "For example, 27 3 1990".

props.name: layout
props.description: `separate`: three labelled boxes in a fieldset, for dates people know by heart (birth, issue dates); the month also takes its name ("mar", "March"). `segmented`: one field of day, month and year parts that step with the arrow keys, the typed path of DatePicker.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the parts' order and the month names; defaults to the page's.
